benchmark_entry.name: Add the gain-to-pain ratio and prove it is nonnegative
benchmark_entry.description: The gain-to-pain ratio is nonnegative when defined.

code.lean:
import MathFin.Performance.PerformanceRatios

open MathFin

/-- The gain-to-pain ratio is nonnegative when defined. -/
theorem mf_performance_gain_to_pain {S : Type*} (finset_S : Finset S) (r : S → ℝ)
    (h : 0 < ∑ s ∈ finset_S, max (-r s) 0) : 0 ≤ gainToPain S finset_S r :=
  MathFin.gainToPain_nonneg_of_denom_pos finset_S r h

benchmark_entry.name: Add the upside-capture ratio and prove positive homogeneity in the portfolio return

code.lean:
import MathFin.Performance.PerformanceRatiosExtended

open MathFin

/-- Upside-capture ratio and its homogeneity. -/
theorem mf_performance_upside_capture {S : Type*} (up : Finset S) (p : S → ℝ) (b : S → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
    (h : ∑ i ∈ up, b i ≠ 0) : upCapture up (c • p) b = c * upCapture up p b :=
  MathFin.upCapture_smul up p b c h

benchmark_entry.name: Formalize the vanilla interest-rate swap value and par swap rate S = (P(0,T₀)−P(0,Tₙ))/(δ·Σ P(0,Tᵢ))
benchmark_entry.description: Vanilla interest-rate swap value and par swap rate.

code.lean:
import MathFin.FixedIncome.InterestRateSwap

open MathFin

/-- Vanilla interest-rate swap value and par swap rate. -/
theorem mf_fixedincome_swap {ι : Type*} (r δ K : ℝ) (T : ι → ℝ) (s : Finset ι) (T_0 T_n : ι) (hT0 : T_0 ∈ s) (hTn : T_n ∈ s) (hδ : δ > 0) (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, MathFin.zcb r 0 (T i) > 0) : payer_swap_value (MathFin.zcb r 0 (T T_0)) (MathFin.zcb r 0 (T T_n)) K (annuity δ (fun i => MathFin.zcb r 0 (T i)) s) = 0 ↔ K = par_swap_rate (MathFin.zcb r 0 (T T_0)) (MathFin.zcb r 0 (T T_n)) (annuity δ (fun i => MathFin.zcb r 0 (T i)) s) :=
  MathFin.payer_swap_value_eq_zero_iff_fixed_rate_eq_par_swap_rate r δ K T s T_0 T_n hT0 hTn hδ hP
